decision_rule: Every minimum rate and every base-improvement gate must pass; otherwise keep the adapter quarantined and out of discovery, defaults, and router training.
provenance_note: These thresholds were declared in the active run before test scoring and persisted after the run; the Git artifact alone is not proof of pre-registration.
reuse_policy: The v1 test result is now exposed. Do not tune or select another candidate against it; create a new group-disjoint holdout for a v2 attempt.
